s2_01_advisory_quality_truth.interpretation: the formal U8S8 artifact is usable and integrated, but the original strict quality booleans remain false and were not rewritten

limitations: QEMU proves AArch64 build and functional portability only; it does not prove native ARM64 latency, throughput, RSS, power, thermals, stability, or device-driver behavior.
The batch design is concurrent batch=1 with one DetectorPipeline and one Ort::Session per worker; it is not true tensor batching.
The model file is local and ignored by Git; public distribution still requires separate source-model and dataset license review.
The matching PyTorch checkpoint is unavailable, so this integration does not recreate PyTorch-to-ONNX lineage.
